senses.gloss: the groove in the mountain slopes made by running water.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:1:4">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵇ</cite> top <he>עד כדי שתפרח הכ׳</he> (ed. <he>הב׳</he>, corr. acc.) until the grooves bloom (are covered with vegetation).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:1:4">Ib.</cite> <he>פרחה כ׳ ולא פסקו</he> if the grooves have bloomed, but the rains have not ceased (set in again); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:30">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ</cite> top <he>עד כדי שתפוח הכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 17:3">Targ. I Kings XVII, 3</cite>.
